name: myRev_myRev
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem myRev_myRev (xs : List α) : myRev (myRev xs) = xs
proofs:
have app (as bs : List α) : myRev (as ++ bs) = myRev bs ++ myRev as := by
    induction as with
    | nil => simp [myRev]
    | cons a as ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, app, ih]
  have rev_eq (zs : List α) : myRev zs = zs.reverse := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.reverse_cons]
  simp [rev_eq]
strategies: Prove an append-reversal helper and induct on xs.
Identify myRev with reverse and use library involutivity.
